_meta.provenance: MIXED — see PROVENANCE below. Read this before trusting any accuracy number.

PROVENANCE.real_captured: 2 samples captured live from this VPS herdr session (REAL-*.txt). Neither was in a blocked-approval state, so they exercise idle/working paths only.
PROVENANCE.format_derived: 48 samples are RECONSTRUCTED, not captured. Prompt shapes are derived from herdr's own shipped detection manifests at ~/.local/state/herdr/agent-detection/remote/*.toml (claude 2026.08.04.1, codex 2026.07.18.1, hermes), which encode the literal marker strings each agent emits ('esc to cancel', 'allow command?', 'allow once'/'deny', etc).
PROVENANCE.CIRCULARITY_WARNING: The same author wrote this corpus AND classify.js. Accuracy measured against it is an upper bound and partially self-fulfilling. It proves the tier LOGIC is coherent; it does NOT prove real-world extraction works. Must be re-validated against captured live blocked prompts before any auto-approve ships.
PROVENANCE.LABEL_CORRECTIONS: adv-011 relabelled T2->T0 after inspection; see its _why. Author error, not classifier error.

tiers.0: auto-approve silently: read-only, inside workspace root
tiers.1: auto-approve + log: test/build argv allowlist only (no edits, per Sola review)
tiers.2: escalate to Dom: everything else, including anything unparsable
